testName: Agentforce Topic Classification & Intent Recognition Routing
steps:
1. Open Agentforce Testing Center / Preview Panel
2. Initialize chat session with test persona "Authenticated Customer"
3. Enter natural language prompt: "Where is my recent shipment for order #99481?"
4. Verify Agent Event Inspector logs intent classification to Topic "Order_Management"
5. In same session, enter prompt variant: "I haven't received package 99481 yet, can you check delivery status?"
6. Verify Agent maintains topic context and routes to the same underlying Order tracking logic
7. Enter out-of-domain prompt: "Who won the World Series in 1998?"
8. Verify Agent triggers polite fallback: "I can only assist with your Salesforce customer account and orders."
